release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.5 Dynamic Two-Live & Single-End Stressing Length Threshold Alerts:
• Configurable Stressing Length Validation: Tendons shorter than the user-configured setting threshold with two live ends are flagged (warning against excessive seating loss).
• Long Tendon Single-End Warning: Tendons exceeding or equal to the setting threshold with only a single live end are flagged to recommend two-live double-end stressing to prevent excessive friction loss.
• Dynamic Settings Binding: Alerts dynamically re-calculate based on whatever threshold value the user enters in Settings (QA > Two-Live Tendons Length Threshold), with instant auto-commit and persistence.
